title: Josiah describes author Max Davis's popping house and nearby barn

tellings.quote: are you a barn man Max like there's animals or there's a Farm by you

plain: A boy named Josiah, one of the nonspeaking children in a documentary about children said to read minds, is said to have described the house of an author named Max Davis as 'popping', along with a barn nearby, without being told about them. Josiah's mother tells it as something she witnessed, recalling the question put to Davis: 'are you a barn man Max, like there's animals or there's a farm by you.' If true, it would mean Josiah picked up details about a stranger's home by some means other than the ordinary senses.
